name: Locations & Movements
description: A neutral, domain-agnostic starter app built entirely on the primitives. Explore points of interest (locations) and origin-to-destination movements, with an agent that answers questions over a single semantic view. No fleet, vehicle, or routing vocabulary - the strongest proof the app core needs zero domain-specific code.
targetUsers: Anyone evaluating the platform on their own data
Domain authors starting a new pack
capabilities: Browse locations on a map and by category
Analyze origin-to-destination movements: counts, distance, duration, daily trend
Ask analytical questions in natural language over the starter semantic view
sampleQuestions: How many locations are there per category?
How many movements are there and what is the average distance?
Show total movement distance by day
What is the average movement duration in minutes?
